description: This file implements functions and templates for handling ConfUi messages, including serialization, deserialization, and message sending over file descriptors, within the Cuttlefish confui namespace.

classes.name: ConfUiMessage
classes.description: Base class for ConfUi messages, providing interface for serialization and session management.

classes.name: ConfUiGenericMessage
classes.description: Template class for generic ConfUi messages with specific command types.

classes.name: ConfUiAckMessage
classes.description: Represents acknowledgment messages in the ConfUi protocol.

classes.name: ConfUiCliResponseMessage
classes.description: Represents CLI response messages in the ConfUi protocol.

classes.name: ConfUiStartMessage
classes.description: Represents start messages with prompts and options.

methods.name: ToConfUiMessage
methods.description: Template function to convert parsed packets into specific ConfUiMessage objects based on command type.

methods.name: RecvConfUiMsg
methods.description: Receives a ConfUi message from a file descriptor, returning a ConfUiMessage object.

methods.name: RecvConfUiMsg (overload)
methods.description: Receives a ConfUi message and verifies session ID.

methods.name: SendAbortCmd
methods.description: Sends an abort command over a file descriptor.

methods.name: SendStopCmd
methods.description: Sends a stop command over a file descriptor.

methods.name: SendStartCmd
methods.description: Sends a start command with prompt and options.
